name: Top 3
tagline: Cuts your list down to the three things that matter today
description: Hand it a sprawling to-do list and it picks the three items that actually deserve today, instead of letting you marinate in all of it. Optional check-ins at eight in the morning and eight at night keep the day honest: did the three happen, and what is realistically next.
author: prorookiegamer
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
